Create an ORIGINAL game sprite part for a truck-mounted water-well drilling rig: a rack of well-lining pipes that bolts onto the truck's flat deck. Image 1 is our approved drill rig, seen from directly above: match its outline weight, shading, palette and finish only. Do NOT redraw the drill rig.

Draw ONLY this part, alone on a plain pure white background: nothing else on the canvas. Tall canvas. Beside the pipes at the bottom, a small square steel cellar frame lies flat: an open square of dark steel channel with four corner bolts.

Style: a sprite for the game RimWorld: a thick near-black outline around every shape, soft flat cel shading with two or three tones per material, muted steel colours, a few small clean details, no texture noise. Not a photograph, not a 3D render, not pixel art.

No text, letters, numbers, logos, people, vehicles, wheels, ground, dirt or shadows. No perspective, no tilt.
